BT_OUT.SECTION_DESC: Stream Volumio playback to a Bluetooth speaker or headphones. The device must be paired once beforehand via 'bluetoothctl' over SSH (pair + trust). Enter its MAC address below.
BT_OUT.ENABLE_DOC: Connects to the configured device and adds it as an MPD output alongside your normal output.
BT_OUT.MAC_DOC: Format XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX. Run 'bluetoothctl devices' over SSH to find it.
BT_OUT.NAME: Device name (optional, for display only)
BT_OUT.NAME_DOC: Just a label to help you remember which speaker this is.
